title: Saudi Arabian Egg Noodles
description: A simple and flavorful recipe inspired by Middle Eastern cuisine. This dish combines the richness of eggs with the comfort of noodles.

ingredients.name: saudi arabian
ingredients.notes: saudi-style spice blend (e.g. sumac, cinnamon, allspice)

instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, scramble the eggs over medium heat.
Add the saudi arabian spice blend to the scrambled eggs and stir well.
Combine the cooked noodles and egg mixture. Serve hot.
Optional: Serve with a side of jammy sauce (e.g. a sweet and spicy sauce made with jam and herbs)
